The supply chain attack affected **`mistralai` PyPI package versions 1.3.0, 1.3.1, and 1.3.2**. If you installed one, uninstall it immediately (`pip uninstall mistralai`) and reinstall only from Mistral’s official distribution channels after verifying the package’s integrity.

[Security Advisories](https://docs.mistral.ai/security/advisories)
